Inside, a smudged pencil note read simply, ‘I loved this place, even when the sea was cruel.’ Mara tucked the bottle into her coat, pausing to watch the waves roll in, already knowing she would leave the light on a little longer that night, as if waiting for someone to answer.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在浅灰色的睡意里，街道空旷得能听见远处洒水车驶过的嗡鸣。沿街的路灯晕着暖黄的光，把梧桐的影子拉得很长，铺在湿漉漉的柏油路面上。便利店的玻璃门亮着灯，店员正打着哈欠整理冷柜。高架桥上偶尔有一辆夜班出租车驶过，车轮碾过路面的声音很快消散在风里。没有早高峰的鸣笛，没有人群的喧闹，只有风卷着落叶擦过墙根，像城市在黎明前轻轻的呼吸。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a big problem by breaking it into smaller, identical copies of the same problem.\n- Think of looking for your lost toy in a stack of boxes: you open the top box, and if there's another box inside, you use the exact same steps to look inside that smaller box.\n- You stop when you reach a small, simple problem you can solve right away, like finding your toy in the smallest box, instead of opening boxes forever."}
